text:
srebot: INCIDENT ALERT · solstice-labs dedicated pool (us-east-2) — elevated error rate on canary shard 3. page: @ravi_oncall, @tilly_platform

srebot: symptom: 5xx from runtime on model-serving instances (quantized-8bit variant). error spikes started ~1965004200, affecting ~12% of requests for Solstice Labs namespace (isolated to their dedicated pool).

ravi_oncall: On it. pulling logs and checking autoscaler. first triage: are other customers on this pool impacted?

tilly_platform: quick check: only Solstice namespace shows errors, other tenants on same pool normal. likely model variant / artifact issue.

emma_prod: customer (Solstice Labs) already messaged via CSM and they see slow responses and some failures on their test traffic. Jess, can you keep them updated?

jess_customer_success: yep, pinged them. told them we’re investigating and will provide ETA within 30m. they asked if we can failover to previous pinned artifact.

ravi_oncall: good note. can we revert canary to the previously pinned artifact? what’s the pinned id?

tilly_platform: checked rollout metadata: current canary artifact = model-serving:v2026.03.14-rc4-q8 (canary on shard 3). previous pinned stable = model-serving:v2026.03.12-stable (artifact id aaf3b2).

alex_se: If we revert the canary image to the stable tag that should stop the 5xxs. downside: loses perf gains but avoids errors.

ravi_oncall: plan: 1) Quarantine Solstice namespace traffic to dedicated pool, 2) pin revert on canary shard 3 -> stable artifact, 3) monitor for 10m, 4) if healthy, promote to remaining canary shards. any objections?

emma_prod: +1. also let's add a short-term traffic limiter to reduce burst until rollback completes.

tilly_platform: execute steps. running command now:

```
# force-deploy stable image to canary shard 3
redwood deploy --pool solstice-dedicated --shard 3 --artifact aaf3b2 --force
```

tilly_platform: command accepted, pushing image. kube pods will rotate. ETA ~2m.

ops-bot: Deploy started by tilly_platform · job id 9f7e2c · will post status updates.

srebot: NOTE: autoscaler temporarily disabled for Solstice pool to avoid scaling churn during rollback.

ravi_oncall: logs stream: seeing `oomkill` traces and a small spike of `bad_alloc` from q8 runtime which matches user reports. reverting should avoid that allocation path.

tilly_platform: pods restarting... new pods report READY on 3/3 for shard 3.

ops-bot: Deploy job 9f7e2c succeeded · all canary pods on shard 3 running artifact aaf3b2.

ravi_oncall: running quick smoke tests against Solstice endpoints. sending synthetic traffic at 10r/s to canary shard 3.

```
# smoke test
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/solstice/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' | jq -r '.status'
```

ravi_oncall: responses OK, no 5xx observed in the last 60s. error rate dropped to 0.4% (was 12%).

emma_prod: notifying Solstice CSM: rollback to stable complete, monitoring continues, ETA 10m to confirm full recovery.

jess_customer_success: confirmed they see requests succeeding now — they asked about root cause and when rc4 will be safe.

tilly_platform: collecting core dumps and metrics for rc4 variant. initial hypothesis: quantization change in rc4 path triggers memory spike under certain prompt token distributions; reproducing locally now.

alex_se: we should block rc4 from future canaries for dedicated pools until patch. I'll open a model-onboarding hold and tag rc4 as blocked.`

srebot: ACTION: create ticket (INC-5963) for qa/repro + blocklist artifact for dedicated pools. assigned to eng-runtime.

ravi_oncall: handing off to tilly for deeper analysis; I’ll remain available if customer impact resurfaces. tilly, you own the postmortem steps and incident follow-up.

tilly_platform: acknowledged. I'll also coordinate with eng-runtime and apply a temporary artifact blacklist: `deny-artifact rc4-q8` for all dedicated pools.

emma_prod: closing loop with CS: update sent, offered scheduled follow-up review tomorrow 10:00am ET.

jess_customer_success: Solstice appreciated the quick rollback. asked if we can schedule a canary re-test with their QA next week after fixes.

tilly_platform: noted. creating RFC for safe canary re-introduction and kv-cache priming checklist.

srebot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated (primary customer impact resolved via pinned-artifact revert). incident will remain open until postmortem and artifact block applied.

ravi_oncall: marking oncall handoff complete. logs & commands:

```
# commands run during mitigation
redwood deploy --pool solstice-dedicated --shard 3 --artifact aaf3b2 --force
redwood autoscaler set --pool solstice-dedicated --enabled false
redwood artifact block add --artifact model-serving:v2026.03.14-rc4-q8 --scope dedicated_pools
```

tilly_platform: will update INC-5963 with repro steps, heap profiles, and timeline. closing thread after postmortem drafts are shared. :white_check_mark:
